selector.rationale: The presence of erythematous papules, scales, and fissures on the lower lip, along with a positive phototest and specific findings on skin biopsy, support the diagnosis of Discoid Lupus Erythematosus.

rejected.label: Photodermatitis
rejected.why: While the patient had a positive phototest, the clinical presentation and biopsy findings are more consistent with Discoid Lupus Erythematosus.

rejected.label: Cutaneous lymphoma
rejected.why: Although the biopsy showed a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate, the presence of germinal centers and the clinical presentation are more consistent with Discoid Lupus Erythematosus or Cutaneous Lymphoid Hyperplasia, but not typical for Cutaneous lymphoma.
